//: The few facts about this app that scripts, hooks and skills need to agree on.
Edit it by hand or let the /setup skill fill it in. No secrets live here — this
file is committed. Keys and passwords belong in .env and in ~/.config/inhouse/.
appName   the name people see in the browser tab and in e-mails.
profile   'solo' — you review, merge and release your own work.
'team' — the agent opens a pull request and stops.
timeZone  an IANA name. The whole app uses this one zone, not the reader's.
locale    a BCP 47 tag. The whole app formats dates and numbers with it.
deploy.host    the SSH alias of your server as it appears in ~/.ssh/config,
never a raw address — addresses are not committed.
deploy.dir     the folder on that server holding compose.yaml.
deploy.domain  the domain the app answers on, for Caddy and for release checks.
